solves.reason: Emotions = unconscious response, feelings = cognitive assignments, key is the distinction between them.
Much more complicated dynamic, most noteworthy application, more concrete exemplar.
More easily grasped, merely helps march, more energetically.
negligible means negligible/trivial, but the context requires noteworthy (most important application). Opposite meaning.
lazily is opposite of energetically. The drum helps march energetically, not lazily.
dramatically implies big effect, but the original is merely (only/just). War drum merely helps march, doesn't determine sides.
The blank is between emotion and feeling — distinction fits perfectly.
Humans have some ability to cognitively assign — to think about and make decisions about emotions.
The sensation of the drums is auditory (hearing). Not emotional, cognitive, or neurological.
grasped in this context means understood (comprehended), not seized physically.
assign here means to attribute/give meaning to emotions, not distribute or delegate.
sensation (sensory input) is closest to perception (awareness through senses).
complicated = complex; straightforward = simple/easy. Elaborate and intricate are synonyms of complicated.
concrete = definite/specific; vague = unclear/indefinite. Tangible and specific are similar to concrete.
(A) set off = triggered/유발하다 (experience set off by sensation). (B) set off = departed/출발하다 (set off early in the morning).
A practical example of what has been described, a model or pattern = exemplar.
'a much more ___ dynamic' needs a comparative adjective. complicate → complicated (past participle as adjective).
'the ___ sensation of the drums' needs an adjective meaning related to hearing. audit → auditory.
feelings are ___ we make to those emotions → the cognitive assignments. First sentence defines feelings this way.
grasped when thinking about ___ — ancient war drums. The dash introduces war drums as that thing: a more concrete exemplar.
